purpose: Give an independent technical evaluator a bounded, hash-verifiable way to supervise the preregistered EIA prospective router experiment and decide whether its evidence advances beyond repository Level 3.

evidence_lane.source_product: Form EIA-930 daily demand and day-ahead demand forecast by balancing authority

clean_runner_verification.artifact_retention_note: The GitHub-hosted artifact has a finite retention window. The verified receipt, scoped SBOM, logs, and checksum manifest are preserved under archive_path.

level_4.label: prospective_public_data_evaluation
required_evidence: no target actual present at seal
router compared with every predeclared fixed specialist
all authority, month, route, fallback, and negative results reported

decision_rights: approve or reject the evaluation protocol before reviewing prospective outcomes
independently verify protocol, prediction-chain, settlement-chain, and receipt hashes
inspect all negative results, fallbacks, exclusions, and missing observations
reject any backfilled prediction or post-target route change
withhold Level 5 signoff when independence, coverage, or evidence custody is insufficient
operator_prohibitions: no result-dependent route or hyperparameter changes
no deletion or replacement of sealed predictions
no operational grid control or autonomous actuation
no realized-savings, reliability, certification, or universal-superiority claim
no evaluator identity or signature fabricated by the operator

nist_ai_rmf_informative_crosswalk.implemented_control: Named operator and evaluator roles, HumanUnlock boundaries, immutable protocol identity, claim prohibitions, and explicit decision authority.
nist_ai_rmf_informative_crosswalk.remaining_gap: No independent evaluator has accepted responsibility or signed the protocol.

nist_ai_rmf_informative_crosswalk.implemented_control: The intended forecast context, EIA source, eight balancing authorities, incumbent comparators, affected operational boundaries, and prohibited uses are documented.
nist_ai_rmf_informative_crosswalk.remaining_gap: An external domain owner has not yet reviewed context suitability or downstream impacts.

nist_ai_rmf_informative_crosswalk.implemented_control: Predeclared metrics, baselines, timing controls, holdout gates, uncertainty tests, append-only receipts, clean-runner replay, and negative-result reporting are defined.
nist_ai_rmf_informative_crosswalk.remaining_gap: Prospective samples and settlements have not reached the confirmatory or durability gates.

nist_ai_rmf_informative_crosswalk.implemented_control: Fail-closed eligibility rules, no-backfill controls, chain-tamper rejection, fallback tracking, stop conditions, and blocked deployment claims are documented.
nist_ai_rmf_informative_crosswalk.remaining_gap: No external organization has adopted an incident, escalation, or production-use decision process for this experiment.

reviewer_decision_request.decision: Accept or decline the independent technical evaluator role for the frozen prospective experiment.
reviewer_decision_request.minimum_commitment: Review the protocol and clean-runner receipt, verify hashes, observe the prospective ledger through the confirmatory gate, and sign only the result supported by the complete record.
reviewer_decision_request.fundable_scope: A bounded independent evaluation and replication engagement may be funded without asserting that Level 4, Level 5, field performance, or economic savings already exist.

claim_boundary: This docket proves only the identity and readiness of a bounded external-validation process. It does not prove Level 4 or Level 5 maturity, independent validation, agency approval, NIST certification, field performance, grid reliability improvement, realized savings, patent validity or scope, production readiness, trading performance, or universal model superiority.
